[Image: Ruler]

Using a centimeter ruler like this one, you can measure accurately to the nearest
figure_description: A centimeter ruler labeled "cm" at the left, with major tick marks numbered from 1 to 11. Between each pair of consecutive whole-centimeter marks (and between 0 and 1), there is exactly one intermediate, unnumbered tick mark of medium length indicating each half-centimeter. There are no smaller millimeter subdivision marks.
